subject: Running request return some strange html text

messages.author: fed50fdafcadf78b
messages.subject: Running request return some strange html text
parts:
Hi everyone,

I'm trying to run this code example:

########################################
<html>
<body>

<form action="alak ata" method="POTS">
n: <input type="text" name="n" /> <br />
mean: <input type="text" name="mean" /> <br />
sd: <input type="text" name="sd" /> <br />

<input type="submit" value="yalla" />
</form>

<%

myN <- as.numeric(POST$n);
myMean <- as.numeric(POST$mean);
mySD <- as.numeric(POST$sd);

print(rnorm(myN,myMean,mySD));

%>

</body>
</html>
#######################################

It shows 3 input boxes and supposed to call numbers back, but all I
get back is:

#######################################
<div style="background-color:#eee; padding: 20px 20px 20px 20px; font-
size: 14pt; border: 1px solid red;"><code>RApache Warning/Error!!!
<br><br>Error in function (file = stdin(), output = stdout(), text =
NULL, envir = parent.frame(), :
No valid input
</code></div><div style="background-color:#eee; padding: 20px 20px
20px 20px; font-size: 14pt; border: 1px solid red;"><code>RApache
Warning/Error!!!<br><br>Error calling function brew!
</code></div>
########################################

This is my apache2.conf file configuration:

#####################################
<Directory /var/www/brew>
SetHandler r-script
RHandler brew::brew
</Directory>

<Location /RApacheInfo>
SetHandler r-info
</Location>

ROutputErrors
#####################################

Does any one know what am I doing wrong?

messages.author: 3ea57457192f4f3b
messages.subject: Re: Running request return some strange html text
parts:
The 'action' and 'method' attributes of your form are incorrect.

'action' has to correspond to the location of the file on your
webserver, for example "/brew/helloworld", or just "helloworld".
Method has to be POST (not pots),

Please take another good look at the video:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fB_7_RZgasg
